summary: 53-year-old David Robles of Westminster failed to return from a Saturday hike in Eldorado Canyon State Park (last heard from Saturday afternoon, 09/05); his car was found at the park. Multi-day RMRG search with Alpine assist (paged 09/06 as day 2, 09/07 day 3, 09/09 day 5); body found ~12:20 p.m. Wednesday 09/09. No signs of foul play; investigators considering a fall.
responding_agency: Rocky Mountain Rescue Group (primary); Alpine Rescue Team (assist); Boulder County Sheriff's Office
notes: Alpine 2015 Missions PDF item 15-100/101/104. Alpine paged 09/06 as day 2, 09/07 as day 3, 09/09 as day 5; folded into one row Outcome per CPR/Daily Camera: body found 09/09 ~12:20 p.m.; 53-year-old David Robles of Westminster (University of Colorado Foundation); no signs of foul play, fall suspected. SARDOC Sept 9 2015 mission report: two SARDOC dog teams responded and searched their assigned areas with interest in some areas but did not find the subject; foot teams found him deceased high on Rattlesnake Ridge.
